result: The original two observed target traces already contain a same-action pair with identical x,y and different z, and different x+ effectiveness. Ordinary transition comparison exposes the conditional dependence without a new experiment or a composite-relation localizer.
scope: One existing selected witness only. This does not establish the complete target action precondition, a global causal graph or a general impossibility result.
decision: Do not implement a follow-up localizer whose claimed advantage is to extract this same context dependence while denying the baseline the intermediate observations.
